crossRefs.note: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men.…
Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
translations.bsb: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
translations.kjv: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
translations.asv: He leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
